pages.title: God's Coffee
pages.text: The most powerful coffee there is. It gives $(thing)six effects$() at once:$(li)Speed II$(li)Regeneration$(li)Night Vision$(li)Resistance$(li)Strength$(li)Haste$(br2)All of them last the same time, set by its quality.
